    # Precompute the sum of digits modulo 3

    for i in range(1, N + 1):

    dp = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1  # Base case: empty subset has sum % 3 == 0
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(3):
            # Option 1: Do not include S[i-1]
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]
            # Option 2: Include S[i-1]
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][(j - (int(S[i - 1]) % 3) + 3) % 3]) % MOD
    
    # The result is the number of valid subsets of S[0:N] with sum % 3 == 0
    return dp[N][0]
